stem: An adolescent sustains an avulsion injury at a ligamentous attachment near a joint; which fracture grouping does this injury belong to?
explanation: Epiphyseal fracture is the correct grouping. This is because epiphyseal fractures are intra-articular and include avulsion injuries of ligamentous attachments near a joint.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because a complete transverse fracture is a shaft-pattern fracture, not the grouping for an avulsion injury at a ligamentous attachment.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because a greenstick fracture is an incomplete cortical injury, not an avulsion fracture grouping.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because epiphyseal fractures are intra-articular and include avulsion injuries of ligamentous attachments near a joint.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because plastic deformation is bowing without a distinct fracture line, not an avulsion injury.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a butterfly fracture is a complete fracture pattern with a wedge fragment, not the category for avulsion injuries.
